items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the exact sequence comparing local cohomology along a specialization-stable subset with the local cohomology along the subset of its nonminimal points (author lemma at source lines 1216-1232, label lemma-filter-local-cohomology), with an explicit colimit term built from the f-torsion of the local cohomology with support in closed subsets. The proof (source lines 1234-1263) is a genuine colimit argument: it degenerates a spectral sequence of another chapter into short exact sequences (proof lines 1234-1240), passes to the filtered colimit over the pairs (Z, f) using the description of the functor supplied by the author's adjoint lemma, and then verifies exactness at the end by producing closed subsets and an element witnessing the required condition (proof lines 1258-1263). The colimit passage and the final exactness check are the substance. H2.
